Unforgottable experience
Jul 2026 • Couples
**An oasis of peace and excellent cuisine in Hoi An ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐**

If you are looking for a refuge away from the hustle and bustle of the crowded streets, **The Soul** is a true hidden gem.

* **The Atmosphere:** From the moment you step inside, you are wrapped in an incredibly relaxing and peaceful atmosphere. The restaurant boasts spacious, beautifully curated areas overlooking a lovely garden. Dining with this view is truly refreshing for the soul.
* **The Service:** The staff is a major highlight of the experience: highly professional, attentive to every single detail, yet always with a level of discretion and warmth that makes you feel pampered from start to finish.
* **The Cuisine:** The food is of outstanding quality. You can clearly taste the freshness of the ingredients and the care put into the preparation, with balanced flavors and beautiful presentation.
* **Value for Money:** Absolutely excellent. Finding such high standards in both food and location at such reasonable prices is a rare find.

> **Highly recommended:** Whether for a romantic dinner or a relaxing lunch, The Soul is a must-visit in Hoi An. I will definitely be back!

Amazing local and western delights
Jul 2026 • Couples
During our stay at the RiverTown resort, we had complimentary. Real fast in the main dining area each morning. Breakfast is served from 6.30am-10am. The dining area is spacious, with a nice ambiance. The breakfast selection was amazing with a wide selection of local and western spreads from fresh Vietnamese spring rolls to croissants. We made sure we had at least a bowl of pho Bo each morning to start the day off with. Choices from the egg menu was varied as well, the egg Benedict was done to perfection. Don’t forget to check out the fridge area for a selection of yoghurt, chia pudding and cream caramel! Breakfast wouldn’t be complete without a cup of Vietnamese coffee of course! 
Service was great, we especially enjoyed friendly greetings from Lan every morning. We were impressed by the friendliness of staff generally.

I was unwell with a cold during my stay and staff went out of their way to assist me-made me ginger tea at breakfast, met my request for salt for me to make a salt gargle, provided ginger slices and lime slices for me to make hot drinks in my room. They helped to make me feel better and recover.

We also had dinner at the garden patio side of the hotel. Again the selection of dishes ranging from local to western were impressive. We were served a complimentary drink and hand towels beforehand. The prices are reasonable as well. At night the garden turns into a fairy land with soft lights and beautiful lanterns on display. Beautiful ambiance, beautiful people! Would highly recommend.
